title: One Perturbation, Two Failure Modes: Probing VLM Safety via Embedding-Guided Typographic Perturbations
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of safety filters in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) against typographic prompt injection attacks. While it discusses 'safety alignment' (the refusal to comply with harmful prompts), it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethical frameworks.
